prompt_en: A blossoming peach branch in a ceramic vase at Tet.
refined_prompt: A blossoming peach branch in a ceramic vase at Tet. A blossoming peach branch, known as "cành đào," is placed in a traditional ceramic vase in the main living room during Tet, the Vietnamese Lunar New Year. The delicate pink blossoms and fresh green leaves of the peach branch enhance the festive atmosphere, symbolizing new beginnings and good fortune for the coming year. The scent of the blossoms fills the air, adding to the sensory experience, while the vase, often intricately designed and colored in green or red, complements the branch's hues. This custom, believed to have originated during the Lê dynasty, is an integral part of Tet celebrations across Vietnam, symbolizing peace and prosperity.
